blocks.text: Space (khala) woh teen dimensions wali wusat hai jis mein saari cheezein aur waqiaat hote hain. Yeh kisi force ke asar mein cheezon ki jagah aur harkat batane ka dhancha deti hai.

Time waqiaat ki tarteeb aur un ka dauraniya (duration) naapta hai. Theory of relativity mein time absolute nahi; ise chautha (fourth) dimension mana jata hai. Misal: jhoolte pendulum jaisi oscillatory (aage peeche) harkat mein frequency time se hi maloom hoti hai. Doosri misal time dilation hai, jo isi chapter mein guzri: bohat tez chalne wale observer ke liye ruke hue observer ke muqable mein time ahista guzarta hai. Theory of relativity batati hai ke space aur time aapas mein jure hue hain, aur speed aur gravity dono un par asar karti hain, jaise sitaron jaisi bhari cheezon ke paas light ka mur jana.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yeh sab special theory of relativity ke khate mein dalti hai. Special theory sirf speed ke asraat batati hai; gravity ka space aur time par asar aur bhari cheezon ke paas light ka murna Einstein ki general theory of relativity batati hai.

Space-time asal mein ek mathematical model hai jo space aur time ko jor kar ek continuum (bina toote silsile) bana deta hai. Is se space aur time ke saare points aur un ka aapas ka rishta bayan hota hai. Einstein ki theory ke mutabiq space-time khaas taur par bohat bhari cheezon ke paas aur light ki speed ke qareeb speeds par mur (curve) jata hai. Ise hum ek kapre ki chadar ki tarah soch sakte hain: chadar par bhari gend rakhein to woh neeche jhuk jati hai, jaisa Fig. 11.2 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Gehrai mein dikhai gayi murabba jaali (grid) wali chadar jis ke beech gehre gaddhe mein bhari neela gola rakha hai; jaali ki lakeerein gole ki taraf neeche jhuk jati hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 11.2: Bhari gola kapre ki chadar ko jhuka deta hai (kitab ki Figure 11.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Bhari gend chadar mein garha bana deti hai; paas se guzarne wali chhoti gend is garhe ki taraf mur jati hai. Isi tarah Suraj jaisi bhari cheez space-time ko morti hai, aur paas ki cheezein aur light is mor ke saath chalti hain. Hum ise gravity mehsoos karte hain.

Sitare aur planets apne gird space-time ko mor dete hain, bilkul jaise lachakdar kapra gend rakhne par jhuk jata hai. Cheez jitni bhari, garha utna gehra. Is liye hum yeh nahi kehte ke jismon par gravity ki force lagti hai; balke kehte hain ke jism aur light ki shuaein (rays) mure hue space-time mein geodesics par chalti hain (geodesic: mure hue space mein seedhi line jaisa sab se chhota rasta). Is liye bhari cheez ke paas ruka hua ya ahista chalta jism geodesic par chal kar usi cheez ki taraf jata hai.

Einstein ki theory batati hai ke gravity asal mein kaise kaam karti hai. Newton ne gravity ka inverse square law (force faasle ke murabba ke ulta) dhoonda, magar saaf kaha ke woh yeh nahi bata sakte ke gravity is law par kyun chalti hai. Einstein ki theory bhi gravity ko inverse square law par chalta batati hai (bohat taqatwar gravitational fields ke siwa), magar yeh bhi batati hai ke aisa kyun hai. Is liye Einstein ki theory Newton se aage ka qadam hai, halan ke is mein Newton ki theory shamil hai aur bohat taqatwar fields ke siwa dono ek hi nateeje deti hain.

Suraj ki gravity se sitaron ki light ka murna 1919 ke Suraj grahan (solar eclipse) mein naapa gaya. Nateeje Newton ke bajaye Einstein ki theory ke mutabiq the, aur Einstein ki theory ko bari scientific kamyabi mana gaya. Ek aur kamyabi gravitational waves ka pata chalna thi: kuch aasmani waqiaat space-time ke mor mein khalal (dabna aur khinchna) paida karte hain, aur yeh lehrein 2015 mein pakri gayin aur 2016 mein elaan hua.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Suraj se sitaron ki light ka murna. Sitare A ki light Zameen ki taraf aate hue Suraj ke qareeb se guzarti hai aur mur jati hai. Hum sitare ko zahiri (apparent) simt B mein dekhte hain, jo zaviya ϕ jitna hat gayi hai. Einstein ne bataya tha ke ϕ = 1.745 seconds of angle (arc) hoga, aur 1919 ke solar eclipse mein yahi naapa gaya.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf Suraj. Sitare A se shua (ray) neeche aati hai, Suraj ke kinare ke qareeb se guzarti hai aur Zameen (To Earth) ki taraf jate hue Suraj ki taraf thora mur jati hai. Dashed lakeer Zameen tak aane wali shua ko peeche zahiri jagah B tak barhati hai; zawiya phi A wali shua aur dashed lakeer ke darmiyan hai.
blocks.caption: Interesting Information (PDF page 257): Suraj se sitaron ki roshni ka murna (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Hamari aankh light ko usi simt mein dekhti hai jis simt se woh aakhir mein aati hai. Suraj ke qareeb light Suraj ki taraf mur jati hai, is liye Zameen se sitara asal jagah A ke bajaye seedhi peeche wali jagah B par nazar aata hai. Yeh zaviya ϕ bohat chhota hai (taqreeban 1.75 seconds of arc); samajhne ke liye khaake mein bara dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Example 11.1
blocks.problem: Pendulum ka period us ke apne inertial frame mein 3.0 s naapa gaya. Pendulum ke nisbat 0.95 c se chalne wala observer us ka period kitna naapega?
steps: tₒ = 3.0 s (proper time), v = 0.95 c, t = ?
blocks.answer: Chalte observer ko period 9.6 s lagta hai: pendulum ki ghari us ke liye taqreeban 3.2 guna ahista chalti hai.

blocks.title: Example 11.2
blocks.problem: 1.0 m lambi chhar (bar) x-axis par rakhi hai aur ruke hue observer ke nisbat 0.75 c se chal rahi hai. Ruka hua observer us ki lambai kitni naapega?
steps: ℓₒ = 1.0 m (proper length), v = 0.75 c, ℓ = ?
blocks.answer: Ruka hua observer chhar ko 0.66 m lamba naapta hai (harkat ki simt mein chhoti).

blocks.title: For your Information
blocks.text: Aap jitna tez chal rahe hon, ya gravity ke kisi taqatwar source ke jitna qareeb hon, aap ke liye time utna hi ahista guzarta hai.

blocks.title: Example 11.3
blocks.problem: 0.8 c speed se chalti cheez ka mass m nikalein.
blocks.answer: 0.8 c par cheez ka mass us ke rest mass ka 1.67 guna ho jata hai.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Agar aap kisi bohat tez spaceship mein black hole ke qareeb hon, jaise film “Interstellar” mein, to aap ki har ek ghante mein Zameen par 7 saal guzar sakte hain.

Ek spaceship light ki aadhi speed se ek sitare ki taraf ja raha hai. Zameen wale observer ke hisab se sitare tak pohanchne mein aath saal lagte hain. Zameen ke nazariye se spaceship ki ghariyan ahista chal rahi hain, is liye spaceship par Zameen ke muqable mein kam waqt guzarta hai.

Spaceship walon ke liye safar ki lambai hi chhoti ho gayi hai (length contraction), jise woh kam waqt mein tay karte hain. Spaceship wale manzil tak pohanchne mein 8 ke bajaye 7 saal record karte hain (8 × √(1 − 0.25) = 8 × 0.866 ≈ 6.9, yani taqreeban 7).

blocks.prompt: Space-time ke baare mein Einstein ka khayal bayan karein aur batayein ke is ke mutabiq gravity kya hai. Kuch misalein dein jahan relativity ke nateeje sach sabit hue.
blocks.explanation: Space aur time mil kar chaar dimensions wala space-time banate hain, jise mass mor deta hai, jaise bhari gend lachakdar chadar mein garha banati hai. Gravity force nahi balke mure hue space-time mein jismon aur light ka geodesics par chalna hai; yeh inverse square law ki wajah batata hai aur sitaron ki light ke murne (1919) aur gravitational waves (2015) ki peshgoi karta hai. Special relativity ki tasdeeq: tez chalte unstable particles time dilation ki wajah se zyada der zinda rehte hain, accelerators mein particles ka mass aur energy barhte hain, aur nuclear reactions mein nikalne wali energy E = mc² ke mutabiq hai.

items: Space: teen dimensions; time: chautha dimension, relativity mein absolute nahi. Space-time dono ko jorta hai; mass ise morta hai (chadar par bhari gend, Fig. 11.2); jism aur light gravity ki force ke bajaye geodesics par chalte hain.
Einstein Newton ke inverse square law ki wajah batata hai: Suraj se sitaron ki light ka murna (1.745 seconds of arc, 1919); gravitational waves 2015 mein pakri gayin.
Examples: 0.95 c par 3.0 s ka period 9.6 s; 0.75 c par 1.0 m ki chhar 0.66 m; 0.8 c par m = 1.67 mₒ. c/2 par spaceship: Zameen par 8 saal, jahaz par taqreeban 7 saal.
